summary: std/x509: an RSA key below 1024 bits no longer verifies a certificate or TLS handshake signature
details: an RSA key below 1024 bits no longer verifies a certificate or TLS handshake signature; the floor was 128 bytes, so a 1017 to 1023 bit key verified where Go refuses it.
changelog: - Security (std/x509, std/tls, native and LLVM backends): an RSA key below 1024 bits no longer verifies a certificate or TLS handshake signature; the floor was 128 bytes, so a 1017 to 1023 bit key verified where Go refuses it.
